title: SoulFactory Nostr-native runtime lifecycle control
description: Define and verify the product/protocol contract for draft-backed SoulFactory provisioning and lifecycle control across Bahia, OpenClaw, and Metiq using signed Nostr events only. The slice keeps Bahia-facing SoulFactory kinds stable, introduces documented runtime-facing control methods, and preserves event-driven relay semantics with no polling or timeout-based terminal states.

actors.name: operator
actors.role: Signs Bahia-facing draft, provisioning, and lifecycle action events.

actors.name: soulfactory_controller
actors.role: Validates operator intent, publishes progress/read-model events, and signs runtime-facing control requests.

actors.name: runtime_bridge
actors.role: OpenClaw TypeScript or Metiq Go bridge that advertises capability, validates controller trust, executes idempotent lifecycle methods, and publishes correlated results.

actors.name: souls_ui
actors.role: Discovers capabilities, saves drafts, publishes signed requests/actions, and tracks explicit relay events.

in_scope: PSTF artifacts for SOUL_FACTORY_RUNTIME_LIFECYCLE with acceptance criteria mapped to tests.
Shared runtime-control protocol document for soulfactory.provision, soulfactory.update, soulfactory.suspend, soulfactory.resume, soulfactory.redeploy, and soulfactory.revoke.
Bahia-facing kinds 31950, 31951, 31952, 5950, 6950, 7950, and 1950 remain the user-facing contract.
Runtime-facing kinds 30317, 38384, and 38386 define capability, request, and result flow.
Trust, validation, idempotency, compatibility, and no-polling/no-timeout protocol requirements.
out_of_scope: Go, JavaScript, or TypeScript runtime implementation changes.
Full avatar generation, voice provider selection, and memory tuning UX.
dependencies: SoulFactory relay bus work must provide scoped subscriptions, EOSE handling, reconnect/backoff, AUTH, CLOSED, OK enforcement, validation, and dedupe before runtime adapters rely on it.
Runtime bridges must publish 30317 capabilities before Bahia enables runtime target selection.
Runtime-control fixtures must be reusable by Go and TypeScript tests to prevent schema drift.
31952 draft schema and 31951 read model extensions must remain additive and backward-compatible.
OpenClaw runtime ownership decision tracked by bahia-nrjg.
non_goals: Introduce REST control APIs for OpenClaw or Metiq management.
Create RPC-over-Nostr semantics that ignore subscription/event-stream behavior.
Treat relay closure or elapsed time as terminal lifecycle success or failure.
